{{for|the similarly named first [[queen]] of [[Andor]]|Ishara Casalain}}
'''Ishara Nawan''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|419}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ishara Nawan}}

==History==
Ishara's name could indicate [[Andor|Andoran]] origin (see [[Ishara Casalain]]).

Ishara held the position for thirty-five years until her death in {{Ne|454}}. She was [[Nirelle Coidevwin]]'s successor and [[Cerilla Marodred]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Ishara was a strong and influential Amyrlin. She continued the policies of her predecessors but in a modified way, because she involved directly the [[White Tower]] in fewer wars. She gained considerable influence but also entangled the Aes Sedai in several dangerous situations that came to a head only after her death.
